title: Schedule Event Record
description: A date-bounded, location-bounded event-level schedule entry for a team, kept separate from match records so a competition window, qualifier, travel block, bootcamp, break, media day, or roster lock can exist on a timeline before opponents, matches, or qualification are known. Future narrative-continuity validation (e.g. 'where was Kairos CS Main between these dates') is intended to be built on this collection; it is empty today. No fictional schedule-event records have been populated by this change.
